frontmatter.title: Optimization
frontmatter.description: TELEMAC model optimization guide covering computational speed improvements, physical correctness calibration, mass conservation, and machine learning-assisted model refinement.

children.value: A numerical model calibration should yield a computationally functional, and physically, at least a reasonably accurate model. Model calibration has already been covered in the

of the steady Telemac2d tutorial. This chapter first provides more tips to increase the physical correctness of a model, especially regarding the conservation of mass, which can sometimes be challenging in Telemac. Additionally, advanced calibration methods that use supervised machine learning to improve physical model accuracy are presented.

This tutorial explains how a Telemac model can be refined by improving its computational stability, and physical correctness. Thus, it is relevant after setting up a Telemac model, as explained for a simple case in the
